# 🚢 Release Checklist

- [ ] Release scope and version approved.
- [ ] Changelog and release notes updated.
- [ ] Documentation and migration notes reviewed.
- [ ] Required tests executed and evidence linked.
- [ ] Build completed and artifact identified.
- [ ] Dependency/security checks reviewed.
- [ ] License and third-party notices reviewed.
- [ ] Secrets and private data excluded.
- [ ] Deployment and rollback plan ready.
- [ ] Post-release smoke checks defined.
- [ ] Known limitations disclosed.
- [ ] Release owner and reviewers recorded.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Version | [Version] |
| Commit | [SHA] |
| Release owner | [Name] |
| Date | [Date] |
| Status | Planned / Approved / Published |
